attempts.title: Original and added supplied research
attempts.mechanism: Reconcile report premises against local code and saved receipts; distinguish duplicate formats from independent methods.

document_review.pdf_visual_review: All six pages rendered and inspected; text and tables read.
document_review.docx: Read complete document.xml paragraphs; a shorter version of the Markdown optimization report, not a third cache algorithm.

local_reconciliation.local_status: Already implemented per layer with token-scaled decay, prefill history cap, 1.10 promotion threshold, and budgeted upload admission.

The paper addresses eviction of future-layer experts from a shared cache. Local cache victims are restricted to the same layer, so that collision mechanism does not apply directly. No promised 85-90% hit rate for Laguna.
Potential future work, not a ready Laguna backend. Predictor training/artifacts needed; Mira also converts experts to its custom INT8 format, unlike the requested existing Q3 GGUF.
Already reuses IQ2/IQ3/IQ4 weight unpacking across groups of 2-4 token rows; Q6 uses standard per-pair dots. 77.35% of groups in the current controlled profile window are singleton groups.
Already retained as budgeted cache admission; uploads are queued after cached slot reads and before CPU expert completion.

local_reconciliation.recommendation: Disable DFlash to reclaim cache VRAM
local_reconciliation.local_status: Fresh same-build comparison measured 16.07 tok/s with DFlash versus 11.36 without, even though draft-off had a larger expert cache. Keep DFlash4.

local_reconciliation.recommendation: Compact SWA allocation and KV budgets
local_reconciliation.local_status: Implemented, but actual allocation uses padded window+ubatch space, not a 512-cell allocation for large prefill. Existing Q8 draft weights are about 1130 MiB rather than report BF16 estimate 2.2 GiB.
AVX2/FMA already enabled. Four-output-row IQ2 candidate reading the original layout was measured slower and fully removed. IK lossless packed R4 layout remains an unmeasured lead.

local_reconciliation.recommendation: Chunk size, thread, speculation sweeps / new benchmark suites
local_reconciliation.local_status: Not adopted: user disallowed sweeps and new tests. Reuse only the saved request and performance_probe.py.

new_measured_comparisons.larger_decode_cache: CPU time -5.13%, no measured generation speed gain, slower reported prefill; restored original cache engine.
new_measured_comparisons.dflash: 41.49% faster observed generation than draft-off on current request; one comparison, no general guarantee.
new_measured_comparisons.iq2_four_output_rows: 14.44 tok/s on versus 15.22 off on identical binaries and request; original layout candidate rejected and completely restored. Not a measurement of persistent R4 packing.

limitations: Research throughput and hit-rate assertions are not measurements on this machine.
Current recall request is one workload, not a general quality benchmark.
No 128k run before 8k gate.
GPU/CPU event intervals overlap and must not be added into a serial-time claim.
